author: The Current
description:
John Linnell of TMBG describes what goes into sequencing an album
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

They Might Be Giants released their 24th album, “The World Is to Dig,” on April 14, 2026. During a recent visit to The Current studio in the midst of four consecutive nights of show in Minneapolis and St. Paul, TMBG’s John Linnell talked about how he and musical partner John Flansburgh go about sequencing albums. “We try and not make it sound samey,” Linnell explains.

Watch more from TMBG’s interview with The Current’s Zach McCormick in the video above, and be sure to subscribe to our channel for more music news, photos, interviews and performances:
